a16z-openai:ashbyhq:e9bea775-7eb6-438a-a.description: About the Team The team’s mission is to accelerate the secure evolution of agentic AI systems at OpenAI. Your role will involve designing and implementing robust security frameworks, policies, and controls to safeguard OpenAI’s critical assets and ensure the safe deployment of agentic systems.
